_meta.anthropic/searchHint: page forms tools actions refs what can I do

description: The full contract of every open tab: each form as a typed tool with its JSON Schema (types, allowed values, min/max, required fields), what those fields currently hold, and every button and link with a ref you can click. This is what you read instead of a screenshot — it is complete, so you should not need to probe. Long pages return a window of their links: the reply always states the true total, and you can narrow with actionQuery or page with actionOffset.

actionOffset.description: Skip this many actions, for paging through a long list.

actionQuery.description: Only return buttons/links whose label contains this text. Use it when you know what you want.
